result.summary: The page appears visually well-formed overall. Layout, spacing, and alignment of the header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation are consistent. No broken images, overlapping elements, or misaligned components were detected. Only very minor cosmetic observations were found.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' cards do not display ratings, while the 'Popular right now' cards do (e.g., Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows 4.8 (500+)). This inconsistency in card metadata may make the fast-delivery cards feel incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Consider showing ratings on all restaurant cards for consistency, or intentionally document the different card templates.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') uses a light gray that has relatively low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Slightly darken the secondary text color to improve readability and meet WCAG contrast guidelines.
